content:
maya: FYI onboarding sampleapp leak: enabling DEBUG_TELEMETRY prints Authorization header before our redaction hook runs.
ryan: ouch. steps to repro?
maya: start sampleapp with DEBUG_TELEMETRY=1, hit /api/complete while mock returns intermittent 503s. headers show Bearer tokens in stdout.
devon: is that the same ordering bug we've seen with otel hooks? middleware order?
maya: looks like it. Also, retry attempts reuse the same reqid across attempts which clutters logs.
alex: can you paste a tiny log snippet (sanitized)?
maya: sure:
```
DEBUG telemetry reqid=abc123 span=span-7 msg="incoming request" headers="Authorization: Bearer <REDACT_ME>"
WARN  http client retry reqid=abc123 attempt=1 status=503
WARN  http client retry reqid=abc123 attempt=2 status=503
ERROR sampleapp reqid=abc123 final-error="upstream 503"
```
ingrid: two issues: (1) auth header logged before redaction, (2) reqid reused across retry attempts. both are poor DX for demos.
dryan: (typo) ryan: Agree. proposal: (A) move redaction middleware to run as the very first middleware, (B) have the http client set a unique x-retry-id per attempt, (C) add an env guard to scrub sensitive headers even in debug mode (REDACT_IN_DEBUG=true).
devon: prototype idea in node express:
```
app.use(redactHeaders) // run first
app.use(reqIdMiddleware)
app.use(otelMiddleware)
httpClient.on('request', (req) => { req.headers['x-retry-id'] = uuid(); })
```
devon: also add test that simulates 3 retries and asserts three distinct x-retry-id values and no Authorization in logs.
ryan: I'll own the node express change and PR. will include changelog blurb and test.
alex: I'll update the sampleapp quickstart and onboarding doc with a warning about DEBUG_TELEMETRY and instructions for REDACT_IN_DEBUG.
ingrid: telemetry-bot: can you run an integration after merges?
telemetry-bot: Queued integration check for branch "telemetry/reqid-reorder" 1 job started.
maya: thanks. once merged, let's post a short note in #all-hands about the demo guidance so new hires don't accidentally leak tokens. :thumbsup:
ryan: SGTM
